newsitem.title: USA: ImmuLogic to begin trial of Allervax Cat.
newsitem.headline: ImmuLogic to begin trial of Allervax Cat.

text.p: ImmuLogic Pharmaceutical Corp said that as a result of an internal company review and meeting with the Food and Drug Administration, it will initiate a product trial of its Allervax Cat in the second quarter of 1997.
The company said it also will modify its development plan to include at least one additional trial prior to a product licensing application submission to the FDA.
Allervax Cat is used to help people allergic to cats.

ImmuLogic Acting President and Chief Executive Dr. Joseph Marr said in a statement that "although significant advances have been made toward demonstrating safety and efficacy, we are discussing with the FDA ways to maximize symptom improvement as well as additional objective measurements of efficacy to be evaluated in the next trial. The FDA will then require at least one additional trial to confirm clinically significant results from the first trial."

In the trial to be initiated in the second quarter of 1997, the company will evaluate the regimen of a 750 microgram dose administered twice a week for two weeks. The specifics of the trial design will be discussed with the FDA over the next couple of months, the company said.
